description: I'm Gary. Forty years as a residential electrician in Ohio, and now I spend my retirement showing regular folks how to keep the lights and the fridge on when the power goes out, without paying for solar panels or a $5,000 generator. Real tests in my own garage, real numbers. New video every week.

videos.title: I Kept My Fridge Cold 3 Days in a Blackout for $60 — No Generator, No Solar
